defects.detail: garbled 'ولذلك قال فارقليطا جميع الانبياء والحاشف عن حقايق انبيائهم' rendered as a confident quotation 'the Paraclete said: "All the prophets and the chosen ... the realities of their prophets."'

'طوبى لمن يرسل الرياح' (blessed is he who sends the winds) rendered 'Glad tidings to whoever sends the winds'

reason: Line-by-line tracking of a noisy Nasta'liq OCR; general sense (Paraclete, Seal of Prophecy, winds of attraction) follows source, but several garbled lines are smoothed into confident readings; I read this hand weakly.

defects.detail: largely incoherent OCR ('ונד' נתדמדם קדוש' ... וחס כמה וד' בג' נשם בקיש הבית'') rendered as continuous prose ('And they were withered, holiness... grace, how much and four in three, he breathed into the house')

reason: Source is garbled Hebrew OCR; translation glosses it word by word (shsakh m"b → 'total of forty-two') without flagging that it is unreadable; the 42-letter-Name note is interpretive.
